title: Plan 2: Object Detection & Player Tracking für Flag Football
summary: Phased implementation plan (German) for a computer-vision player-tracking pipeline from drone video to field-coordinate positions and coaching metrics, with go/no-go gates and a license-clean tech stack.
notes: Ambiguity between SPEC and DOC: prose-heavy phased plan, but contains binding technical constraints (go/no-go acceptance thresholds: >=90% track continuity, <=1m position error, <1h inference; license constraint avoiding AGPL Ultralytics-YOLO; stack decision table).
